data.name: CarboHeroes
data.description: CarboHeroes GmbH is a Berlin-based biochar project developer running pilot pyrolysis projects in Costa Rica with plans to scale across Latin America. The company is listed on Puro.earth as "Costa Rica 1" and is funded through CORC carbon-removal credits, with biochar incorporated into agricultural soils for co-benefits. The Puro listing shows the project in early development stage with feasibility study ongoing and no CORCs issued.
